### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Club late-cancellation charge for booking `96ffb754…`** (charge_club_late_cancel_73de6594.amount_usd)
- Baseline (club_late_cancel_charge_visit_value): price paid / included visits = 74.99 / 1 = 74.99, rounded half up once.
- Factor tiers:
  - Notice (club_late_cancel_notice_hours; `notice_hours: 14`, 24-h notice): "12 to 23" → × (24−14)/24.
  - Missed-visit courtesy (club_missed_visit_courtesy; one `groom_visit_forfeit` since joining, no no-shows): exactly one → 0.75.

  - Clinic relief (wellness_plan_office_visit_relief_club; plan active, latest office visit 2026-09-30, 4 days before appointment 2026-10-04; telehealth 2026-10-03 excluded): 50 %.
  - Tailwise Plus relief: none on the club charge (plus_member_relief_club_etf "does not touch club late-cancellation charges"; the pass-fee Plus relief is for prepaid passes only).
- Charge = 74.99 × 10/24 × 0.75 × 0.5 × 0.5 = 5.85859375 → **5.86**.

**(b) Club cancellation settlement** (cancel_groom_club_74a11dc2.settlement_usd)
- Baseline (club_cancellation_settlement_schedule): ETF (25.00 when billed months < 3) + every club late-cancellation charge booked, rounded half up once.
- Factor tiers:
  - ETF by billed months (club_early_termination_by_billed_months; 2 billed months): 25.00 × (3−2)/3 = 8.3333…
  - Billing-notice multiplier (club_etf_billing_date_proximity; 2026-10-05 → next billing 2026-10-09 = 4 days): 1.1.
  - Plus relief (Tailwise Plus Monthly active): 25 %; shopper relief (order lines in the last 12 whole calendar months: 4 lines, 312.40; the 2025-08-30 line is outside under either reading of the window): 15 %; usage relief (2 completed visits): 10 %. Combined additively 50 %, reduces the ETF once.
  - ETF = 8.3333… × 1.1 × 0.5 = 4.583333…
  - Club late-cancellation charges collected (club_late_cancel_charges_in_settlement; after (a) exactly one entry of 5.86): 0.5 → 2.93.
- Settlement = 4.583333 + 2.93 = 7.513333 → **7.51**.
- Fall-back (baseline docs only): charge 74.99; settlement = 25.00 + 74.99 = **99.99** (≠ 7.51). Definite from the membership-terms schedule and rate card figures the baseline docs name.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what was asked": excluded — settlement "not yet fixed" while ae07508d lacks its entry; settling without it would also omit the owed charge from "every club late-cancellation charge booked on the club".
- Alternatives excluded: charging for the 2026-08-21 forfeit cancellation (remedy forfeit → none); counting the joining fee as a billed month (excluded: "the first fee, charged when the club was joined, is not a billed month"); telehealth 2026-10-03 as office visit (excluded); Plus relief on the club charge (excluded); applying reliefs sequentially (excluded: "first added into one relief percentage"); multiplying charges by the billing-notice multiplier (excluded: "club late-cancellation charges are not multiplied by it"); counting the 2025-08-30 order line (outside 12 whole calendar months); booking against the cancellation entry id (excluded). Closing date 2026-10-08 = "the last day of the current billing month" = expiry date on the record.
- Policy-side observation (not a defect): the club clinic-relief document does not state a combination rule for several percentage reliefs on the club charge; only one such relief applies in this world, so the number is unaffected.
